A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have generated an anti-idiotypc antibody specific for an idiotope expressed on a native anti-BMZ antibody from a bullous pemphigoide patient, and that we have detected a cross-reactive idiotypc expressed on a significant proportion of the circulating anti-BMZ antibodies present in the serum of bullous pemphogoid patients.

The main takeaway from our work is that
anti-Id3-17 can detect a CRI in BP sera that can be useful in the diagnosis of this disease.
anti-idiotyping is a powerful technique for the study of autoantibodies.
